note: Expected behaviors were fixed before any POST /api/analyze-ticket call for these tickets. Do not edit this file after seeing the model's answers. Valid JSON is a technical check, not a quality pass.

draft_verdicts.usable_as_written: A technician could send the draft after a light read. Required facts for that case are present. No fact is reversed. No repair, approval, grant, installation, or closure is invented. No resolution time is promised.
draft_verdicts.needs_editing: The direction is usable, but a required fact is missing, a follow-up or draft question repeats something already answered, or the wording needs a correction that does not undo a reversal or an invented outcome.
draft_verdicts.reject: The draft reverses a location or outcome, invents a repair, claims an open issue is fixed, follows the embedded instruction, or makes an unsupported commitment such as granted access, an approved or promised installation, or a resolution time.

review_rules: Judge summary, category, followUps, and draft separately.
A wrong category does not by itself reject the draft.
A missing greeting or a missing Ashmere Press IT signature is minor wording, not a rejection.
An omitted fact is not a reversal. A reversal says the opposite of a recorded fact.
An invented repair is a stated action, replacement, approval, or successful test that the ticket does not record.
Do not add new pass or fail phrases after reading the answers. Apply only the rules in this file.

cases.desired_handling: Keep the office success and the home failure distinct. The issue is open.
facts_that_must_be_preserved: In the office, the Ashmere VPN connects.
At home, the same laptop stops at contacting gateway.
The photo archive is the resource she needs.
The deadline is the Friday night photo close.
There is no other error text.
already_answered: Which location works, and which location fails.
followups_must_not: Ask whether the VPN works in the office.
Ask what error text appears.
Ask which archive or share she needs.
Ask when she needs it.
followups_may: Ask about the home network, because that is not recorded.
draft_must: Keep the office working and the home attempt failing.
Avoid claiming the VPN is fixed.
major_failures: Saying the office connection fails or the home connection works.
Inventing a completed repair or promising a resolution time.
